g.text: SOCKET VIEW: component side, antenna UP, USB DOWN; top pin = 1. All footprints require physical verification.

g.text: Power source: WeAct J1-1/2. Regulator capability unverified. No external supply in parallel. No 5V cartridge connection.

g.desc: Power source: WeAct J1-1/2. Regulator capability unverified. No external supply in parallel. No 5V cartridge connection.

g.desc: CONTROL PULLUPS: cartridge side; R31 after JP1. GPIO3 strap HIGH requires JP2 installed and common power.
